title: Sessions
description: What a session is shown and told: its turns and what it worked on, on its page; the Sessions view and how a session's state is marked; and what every session is told at its start. Split out of core with its ids kept: the run type stays in core, which the kernel reads.

rules.say: A session's own record of itself (it began, was named, waits, ended) is bookkeeping: it applies as it is made, as the agent it is for.

styles.title: Estimate what you take on
styles.body: When you take on a task that has no estimate, give it one: how many tokens you expect it to take, one number for input and output together (props.tokens_estimated, with change). What is actually used is measured from this session and shown beside it.

styles.title: Report in and tell the story
styles.body: The map is the record of this work, not the chat: what is only said in chat is lost to the owner and the next session. Each time you conclude something (a cause, a finding, a choice and why), tell it with report, action tell (run {run}): one sentence and the items it is about, before you say it in chat; and change each item it settles. Do it unasked: a reply that worked and told nothing is asked to. With the pelago tools (query reads, change writes, every other action under its verb): on taking on one of these, report session_update with its id as task; propose changes with change, run {run}. Before you finish, report session_end with a summary: it asks about what is still open here that nobody changed since you began. A session that ends without it is recorded as not reconciled.
